logline: An investigative deep dive into the hidden cognitive biases, psychological glitches, and neurological survival mechanisms that govern human behavior, grounded strictly in empirical 20th-century scientific research.

target_audience.persona: High-agency, intellectually curious knowledge workers, creators, and students who experience unspoken psychological friction (hesitation, decision fatigue, impostor anxiety, focus decay) and demand empirical mechanisms rather than pop-psychology clichés.
target_audience.core_desire: Understand the exact biological reason behind their daily friction and acquire a 5-second behavioral override.

tone_and_voice.perspective: Visceral 2nd-person immediate reality ('You stare at the screen...', 'If you collapse on a crowded street...')
tone_and_voice.delivery: Intimate, steady Shure SM7B studio ribbon microphone tone with warm low-frequency proximity effect; calm, measured authority without hype or frantic shouting.
tone_and_voice.cadence: 145-155 words per minute with 0.08s tactical micro-pauses at pivotal cognitive turns.
tone_and_voice.scientific_contract: Every episode must introduce a verified academic study, named primary researcher, publication year, and exact quantitative statistic within the first 12-18 seconds.
tone_and_voice.loop_bridge: Ends on a mid-thought connector ('...which explains why...') with zero pause to create an algorithmic infinite replay loop.

visual_art_direction.film_stock: Kodak Portra 400 tonal response, organic micro-grain, authentic skin pores
visual_art_direction.lighting: Soft directional chiaroscuro, volumetric natural window light, subtle warm incandescent bounce
visual_art_direction.primary_setting: The Study Desk — an intimate analytical workspace featuring a dark walnut desk, vintage green banker's lamp, analog reel tape recorder, physical notebook, and rain-streaked window.

vertical_safe_band.rule: All primary subjects and on-screen text must sit inside 0.44-0.76 frame height, strictly clearing top hook banners and bottom Shorts UI buttons.

beat_structure.goal: Visceral 2nd-person symptom + counter-intuitive stakes (Hook Score >= 70 target)
Demonstrate the everyday failure state the viewer recognizes
Introduce primary researcher, institution, and publication year
State the exact numerical statistic that proves the phenomenon
Visual recreation of the laboratory or field testing setup
Locate the biological circuit (prefrontal cortex, amygdala, dopamine loop)
Actionable cognitive reset to overcome the automatic reflex
One explicit viewer ask (subscribe/comment) + seamless '...which explains why...' loop bridge
